thread:
alice: Heads up — we’re seeing a latency bump for hosted-prod in us-west-2 starting ~00:15 UTC. P50 up ~80ms, p95 up ~420ms. Error rate small but increased retries. Rolling canary looks degraded.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated for release v1.3.2-hotfix (canaries: 3). Status: canary-3 failing health checks. Logs: `KV cache miss spike`
ben_ops: Confirmed. Root cause looks like a routing rule that prefers v1.3.2 variant without cache priming; fallback path doing full prefix fetchs. I have a cherry-pick ready that pins routing to v1.3.1 behavior while keeping the batching fix. Patch branch: release/hotfix/pin-routing-1765
carol_release: We need expedited approval to push patch to prod. @david_sre — any objections for a fast-track deploy in the next 10m? We have a 30m change window where SLOs are lenient.
david_sre: Oncall OK with fast-track if we do a canary->50% validation then push. Need rollback command and runbook updated.
emma_pm: Product ok — prioritizing user latency. Approve to expedite. :+1:
alice: Plan: 1) Pause wider rollout (deploy-bot: paused). 2) Apply cherry-pick to canary and run perf smoke. 3) If canary p95 < 250ms and error rate drops, promote. If not, rollback to v1.3.1 across fleet.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused (requested by alice). Canary instances frozen: canary-1, canary-2, canary-3.
ben_ops: Smoke commands: ```
# apply hotfix to canary
git checkout release/hotfix/pin-routing-1765 && git cherry-pick 12ab34c
./deploy --env=prod --subset=canary --image=redwood/inference:v1.3.2-hotfix
# rollback (if needed)
./deploy --env=prod --version=v1.3.1 --force
```
carol_release: We should pin Dedicated pools too, not just hosted. Ben — can you ensure the deployment config includes model-pin: v1.3.1 for pools that hit the routing rule?
ben_ops: Will do. I’ll push a config update to dedicated-configs/prod/pinning.json and trigger a config sync.
david_sre: Adding a short blackout on config changes for the next 15m except this patch. I'll annotate the runbook and add the rollback commands to the incident ticket.
alice: Can someone please do the expedited approval in the release tool? I don’t have perms.
carol_release: Approved in release tool and added note: "expedite: latency hotfix — pin routing to v1.3.1 behavior". @ben_ops please monitor metrics for 10m after canary apply.
ben_ops: Applying to canary now. Will comment updates as metrics come in.
[~2m later]
ben_ops: Canary applied. p50 back to baseline, p95 down to ~220ms, error rate normalized. Rolling to 50% for validation.
david_sre: Monitoring. If we see any regression, we abort and rollback.
emma_pm: Thanks team. Bring this to 100% if stable.
ben_ops: Promoting to 100% now. Deploy-bot will post final status.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete: v1.3.2-hotfix promoted with routing pin. Health: OK. Metrics: p95 <= 240ms across regions.
alice: Nice work. Please add note to release notes: "v1.3.2-hotfix: routing pin to mitigate KV cache misses; restores latency SLOs; temporary pin will be lifted after stability window".
carol_release: Will add release note and close the expedited approval ticket. :white_check_mark:
[thread closed]
